title: 隧道地表沉陷監測~Surface-settlement monitoring for tunneling
focus: 以基準穩定、沉陷槽形與時間關聯區分開挖及地下水影響~Separate excavation and groundwater effects using stable benchmarks, trough geometry and time correlation
summary: 本課聚焦以基準穩定、沉陷槽形與時間關聯區分開挖及地下水影響。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。~This course focuses on separate excavation and groundwater effects using stable benchmarks, trough geometry and time correlation. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.

units.title: 沉陷槽形與參數~Settlement-trough geometry
units.mechanism: 高斯沉陷槽用最大沉陷和寬度概括橫向地表變形，適合初步描述卻未必適合淺覆土、分層或強烈建物約束。斷面不足時兩參數互相補償，應以完整測點而非只看中線峰值。 假設Smax=10 mm、i=5 m，x=5 m處S=10e⁻⁰·⁵=6.07 mm；假設沉陷向下為正。 用單點峰值推算整個沉陷槽會漏掉偏斜與多峰，擬合曲線可能穿過資料卻錯估影響範圍；鄰近建物的差異沉陷便被低估。~A Gaussian trough summarizes transverse movement with peak settlement and width, but shallow cover, layering and structural restraint can violate it. Sparse observations allow parameters to compensate for each other, requiring a full profile rather than only the centerline. Assume Smax=10 mm and i=5 m; at x=5 m, S=10e⁻⁰·⁵=6.07 mm, taking downward settlement as positive. Inferring the entire trough from one peak misses skew and multiple lobes. A fitted curve can pass through the available data yet misrepresent the influence zone and underestimate differential building movement.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設Smax=10 mm、i=5 m，x=5 m處S=10e⁻⁰·⁵=6.07 mm；假設沉陷向下為正。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume Smax=10 mm and i=5 m; at x=5 m, S=10e⁻⁰·⁵=6.07 mm, taking downward settlement as positive.
units.verify: 以同一時間窗的橫斷面測點擬合並檢查殘差是否偏向一側，與地層及建物分布對照；量測涵蓋槽外穩定點，未覆蓋兩翼的斷面不得宣稱已可靠辨識槽寬。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：用單點峰值推算整個沉陷槽會漏掉偏斜與多峰，擬合曲線可能穿過資料卻錯估影響範圍；鄰近建物的差異沉陷便被低估。~Fit points from one time window and inspect asymmetric residuals against geology and buildings; include stable points outside the trough and do not claim reliable width identification when both flanks are unobserved. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Inferring the entire trough from one peak misses skew and multiple lobes. A fitted curve can pass through the available data yet misrepresent the influence zone and underestimate differential building movement.
units.failure: 用單點峰值推算整個沉陷槽會漏掉偏斜與多峰，擬合曲線可能穿過資料卻錯估影響範圍；鄰近建物的差異沉陷便被低估。~Inferring the entire trough from one peak misses skew and multiple lobes. A fitted curve can pass through the available data yet misrepresent the influence zone and underestimate differential building movement.
units.misconception: 量到沉陷槽中央最大值就能唯一決定槽的寬度。~The maximum centerline settlement uniquely determines the trough width.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄沉陷槽形與參數的資料來源與適用條件。以同一時間窗的橫斷面測點擬合並檢查殘差是否偏向一側，與地層及建物分布對照；量測涵蓋槽外穩定點，未覆蓋兩翼的斷面不得宣稱已可靠辨識槽寬。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for settlement-trough geometry. Fit points from one time window and inspect asymmetric residuals against geology and buildings; include stable points outside the trough and do not claim reliable width identification when both flanks are unobserved.

units.title: 體積損失換算~Volume-loss conversion
units.mechanism: 地表沉陷面積代表每單位隧道長度的地表體積變化，與開挖面積比得到表觀體積損失。排水固結、隆起與橫向位移會改變對應關係，不能把它視為直接秤出的超挖土量。 假設Smax=0.01 m、i=5 m，Vs=√(2π)iSmax=0.1253 m²；直徑6 m面積28.274 m²，VL=0.443%。 把毫米當公尺會使體積損失放大千倍，漏掉槽翼又會系統性低估；不同時間的峰值和寬度混用，則會算出未曾存在的沉陷體積。~Surface settlement area gives volume change per unit tunnel length, and its ratio to excavation area is apparent volume loss. Consolidation, heave and lateral movement alter the correspondence, so it is not directly weighed overexcavated soil. Assume Smax=0.01 m and i=5 m; Vs=√(2π)iSmax=0.1253 m². A 6 m diameter gives area 28.274 m² and VL=0.443%. Confusing millimetres with metres inflates volume loss a thousandfold; omitted flanks underestimate it. Combining peak and width from different epochs creates a settlement volume that never actually occurred.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設Smax=0.01 m、i=5 m，Vs=√(2π)iSmax=0.1253 m²；直徑6 m面積28.274 m²，VL=0.443%。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume Smax=0.01 m and i=5 m; Vs=√(2π)iSmax=0.1253 m². A 6 m diameter gives area 28.274 m² and VL=0.443%.
units.verify: 以量測斷面數值積分和高斯積分互相核對，統一沉陷單位與開挖直徑；比較施工後不同時段的面積變化，若有地下水降低，將延時固結與即時開挖損失分別討論。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把毫米當公尺會使體積損失放大千倍，漏掉槽翼又會系統性低估；不同時間的峰值和寬度混用，則會算出未曾存在的沉陷體積。~Cross-check numerical profile integration against the Gaussian integral with consistent units and excavation diameter; compare later epochs and distinguish delayed consolidation from immediate excavation loss where groundwater has fallen. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Confusing millimetres with metres inflates volume loss a thousandfold; omitted flanks underestimate it. Combining peak and width from different epochs creates a settlement volume that never actually occurred.
units.failure: 把毫米當公尺會使體積損失放大千倍，漏掉槽翼又會系統性低估；不同時間的峰值和寬度混用，則會算出未曾存在的沉陷體積。~Confusing millimetres with metres inflates volume loss a thousandfold; omitted flanks underestimate it. Combining peak and width from different epochs creates a settlement volume that never actually occurred.
units.misconception: 地表體積損失百分比就是直接量得的超挖土量百分比。~Surface volume-loss percentage is a directly measured overexcavation percentage.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄體積損失換算的資料來源與適用條件。以量測斷面數值積分和高斯積分互相核對，統一沉陷單位與開挖直徑；比較施工後不同時段的面積變化，若有地下水降低，將延時固結與即時開挖損失分別討論。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for volume-loss conversion. Cross-check numerical profile integration against the Gaussian integral with consistent units and excavation diameter; compare later epochs and distinguish delayed consolidation from immediate excavation loss where groundwater has fallen.

units.anchor: 穩定基準與閉合~Stable benchmarks and closure
units.title: 穩定基準與閉合~Stable benchmarks and closure
units.mechanism: 沉陷是相對基準的高程變化，基準點自己移動時整個監測網會出現共同假訊號。基準需位於影響區外且有冗餘連接，水準路線閉合只能檢查內部一致，不能證明全網絕對穩定。 假設觀測點讀得下沉8 mm，基準本身下沉3 mm，真實相對外部穩定基準沉陷為11 mm。 全網基準同時沉陷可能讓所有監測點看似不動，閉合差仍然很小；若只相信內部閉合，累積沉陷會被悄悄從風險圖中扣掉。~Settlement is elevation change relative to a benchmark. A moving reference creates a common false signal. Redundant external references are required; leveling closure tests internal consistency but does not prove absolute network stability. If an assumed point appears to settle 8 mm relative to a benchmark that itself settles 3 mm, settlement relative to a stable external datum is 11 mm. Common settlement of the references can make monitored points appear stationary while closure remains small. Trusting internal closure alone silently removes accumulated movement from the risk assessment.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設觀測點讀得下沉8 mm，基準本身下沉3 mm，真實相對外部穩定基準沉陷為11 mm。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. If an assumed point appears to settle 8 mm relative to a benchmark that itself settles 3 mm, settlement relative to a stable external datum is 11 mm.
units.verify: 閉合水準網連到多個外部控制點，檢查共同位移模式與獨立GNSS或深層基準證據；基準疑似移動時保留原讀值，經測量主管核准後以可追溯方式重建高程歷程。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：全網基準同時沉陷可能讓所有監測點看似不動，閉合差仍然很小；若只相信內部閉合，累積沉陷會被悄悄從風險圖中扣掉。~Close the leveling network to multiple external controls and compare common movement with independent GNSS or deep benchmarks; preserve raw readings when a reference is suspect and reconstruct elevations traceably under survey-lead review. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Common settlement of the references can make monitored points appear stationary while closure remains small. Trusting internal closure alone silently removes accumulated movement from the risk assessment.
units.failure: 全網基準同時沉陷可能讓所有監測點看似不動，閉合差仍然很小；若只相信內部閉合，累積沉陷會被悄悄從風險圖中扣掉。~Common settlement of the references can make monitored points appear stationary while closure remains small. Trusting internal closure alone silently removes accumulated movement from the risk assessment.
units.misconception: 水準網閉合差很小，就證明所有基準點絕對穩定。~A small leveling closure proves absolute stability of every benchmark.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄穩定基準與閉合的資料來源與適用條件。閉合水準網連到多個外部控制點，檢查共同位移模式與獨立GNSS或深層基準證據；基準疑似移動時保留原讀值，經測量主管核准後以可追溯方式重建高程歷程。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for stable benchmarks and closure. Close the leveling network to multiple external controls and compare common movement with independent GNSS or deep benchmarks; preserve raw readings when a reference is suspect and reconstruct elevations traceably under survey-lead review.

units.anchor: 差異沉陷與傾斜~Differential movement and tilt
units.title: 差異沉陷與傾斜~Differential movement and tilt
units.mechanism: 建物受影響不只看總沉陷，支承間的差異與曲率會誘發結構變形。剛體傾斜與彎曲須分開，因為相同兩點高差可能代表整棟轉動或局部損傷，單一角度不能自動判定損害。 假設兩支點距10 m、高差5 mm，角變化Δ/L=0.0005 rad=1/2000；非通用損害門檻。 只看最大沉陷可能忽略短距離高梯度，反之大範圍均勻沉陷也可能被誤判為嚴重彎曲；錯誤分類會讓保護措施沒有針對真正受力路徑。~Structural effects depend on differential movement and curvature as well as total settlement. Rigid tilt differs from bending: the same two-point difference may describe whole-building rotation or local distortion, so one angle cannot directly diagnose damage. For assumed support spacing 10 m and differential movement 5 mm, Δ/L=0.0005 rad=1/2000; this is not a universal damage threshold. Maximum settlement alone misses steep local gradients, while broad uniform movement may be mistaken for severe bending. Misclassification directs protective measures away from the actual structural load path.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設兩支點距10 m、高差5 mm，角變化Δ/L=0.0005 rad=1/2000；非通用損害門檻。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed support spacing 10 m and differential movement 5 mm, Δ/L=0.0005 rad=1/2000; this is not a universal damage threshold.
units.verify: 將建物角點水準、傾度與裂縫計同步比較，扣除可識別剛體分量後再檢查曲率；容許值由結構型式、既有缺陷及業主要求決定，不能把教學比值當自動停工標準。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：只看最大沉陷可能忽略短距離高梯度，反之大範圍均勻沉陷也可能被誤判為嚴重彎曲；錯誤分類會讓保護措施沒有針對真正受力路徑。~Synchronize corner levels, tilt and crack gauges and examine curvature after identifiable rigid-body movement; criteria depend on structure, existing defects and owner requirements, not the teaching ratio as an automatic stop-work limit. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Maximum settlement alone misses steep local gradients, while broad uniform movement may be mistaken for severe bending. Misclassification directs protective measures away from the actual structural load path.
units.failure: 只看最大沉陷可能忽略短距離高梯度，反之大範圍均勻沉陷也可能被誤判為嚴重彎曲；錯誤分類會讓保護措施沒有針對真正受力路徑。~Maximum settlement alone misses steep local gradients, while broad uniform movement may be mistaken for severe bending. Misclassification directs protective measures away from the actual structural load path.
units.misconception: 建物總沉陷最大時，一定也承受最大的彎曲損傷。~The building with the largest total settlement necessarily suffers the most bending damage.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄差異沉陷與傾斜的資料來源與適用條件。將建物角點水準、傾度與裂縫計同步比較，扣除可識別剛體分量後再檢查曲率；容許值由結構型式、既有缺陷及業主要求決定，不能把教學比值當自動停工標準。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for differential movement and tilt. Synchronize corner levels, tilt and crack gauges and examine curvature after identifiable rigid-body movement; criteria depend on structure, existing defects and owner requirements, not the teaching ratio as an automatic stop-work limit.

units.anchor: 速率與時間窗~Rates and time windows
units.title: 速率與時間窗~Rates and time windows
units.mechanism: 沉陷速率是差分量，時間窗越短越容易放大量測雜訊，越長則可能抹去施工事件。必須把測讀頻率與可能變形速度相配，並將實際時間間隔保留，不能假設所有測次等間距。 假設24 h沉陷增加2 mm，平均速率0.0833 mm/h；若同變化集中在2 h則局部平均1 mm/h。 時間戳錯誤或漏測可產生假加速度，過長平均又會讓急遽變形延後被發現；將速率與累積量分開審查才能辨識兩種相反風險。~Settlement rate is a difference quotient: short windows amplify noise while long windows obscure events. Sampling must match possible movement speed, retaining actual timestamps rather than assuming equally spaced readings. An assumed 2 mm increase over 24 h averages 0.0833 mm/h; if concentrated within 2 h, the local average is 1 mm/h. Incorrect timestamps or missed observations create false acceleration, while excessive averaging delays recognition of rapid movement. Reviewing rate and accumulated displacement together is necessary to identify these opposite risks.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設24 h沉陷增加2 mm，平均速率0.0833 mm/h；若同變化集中在2 h則局部平均1 mm/h。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed 2 mm increase over 24 h averages 0.0833 mm/h; if concentrated within 2 h, the local average is 1 mm/h.
units.verify: 並列原始位移、不同窗長速率與施工事件時間，確認尖峰是否超過儀器噪音；不得平滑後刪除異常，監測負責人應先核對測點狀況，再依核准應變計畫處理持續加速。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：時間戳錯誤或漏測可產生假加速度，過長平均又會讓急遽變形延後被發現；將速率與累積量分開審查才能辨識兩種相反風險。~Display raw movement, rates from several windows and construction timestamps, checking peaks against noise; do not erase anomalies through smoothing, and verify point condition before applying the approved response plan to sustained acceleration. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Incorrect timestamps or missed observations create false acceleration, while excessive averaging delays recognition of rapid movement. Reviewing rate and accumulated displacement together is necessary to identify these opposite risks.
units.failure: 時間戳錯誤或漏測可產生假加速度，過長平均又會讓急遽變形延後被發現；將速率與累積量分開審查才能辨識兩種相反風險。~Incorrect timestamps or missed observations create false acceleration, while excessive averaging delays recognition of rapid movement. Reviewing rate and accumulated displacement together is necessary to identify these opposite risks.
units.misconception: 任何時間窗算出的平均沉陷速率都有相同工程意義。~Average settlement rates from any time window have the same engineering meaning.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄速率與時間窗的資料來源與適用條件。並列原始位移、不同窗長速率與施工事件時間，確認尖峰是否超過儀器噪音；不得平滑後刪除異常，監測負責人應先核對測點狀況，再依核准應變計畫處理持續加速。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for rates and time windows. Display raw movement, rates from several windows and construction timestamps, checking peaks against noise; do not erase anomalies through smoothing, and verify point condition before applying the approved response plan to sustained acceleration.

units.anchor: 精度與差值不確定~Precision of displacement differences
units.title: 精度與差值不確定~Precision of displacement differences
units.mechanism: 兩次高程相減會累積各測次不確定性，若共享同一儀器校準，誤差還可能相關。解析度只是最小顯示增量，不等於可辨識沉陷；判斷微小變化時需有重複測量與環境補償。 假設兩次高程各標準不確定0.5 mm且獨立，差值u=√(0.5²+0.5²)=0.707 mm。 以0.1 mm顯示位數宣稱0.1 mm準確度會過度解讀噪音，若只挑單次最大變化又會製造假警報；反覆誤報可能削弱團隊對真異常的反應。~Differencing elevations combines epoch uncertainties, which may correlate through shared calibration. Resolution is only display increment, not detectable settlement. Small changes require repeat observations and environmental checks before interpretation. Assuming independent elevation standard uncertainties of 0.5 mm at each epoch, the difference has u=√(0.5²+0.5²)=0.707 mm. Claiming 0.1 mm accuracy from display resolution overinterprets noise, while choosing the largest single difference creates false alarms. Repeated false alerts can weaken the response to genuine abnormal movement.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設兩次高程各標準不確定0.5 mm且獨立，差值u=√(0.5²+0.5²)=0.707 mm。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assuming independent elevation standard uncertainties of 0.5 mm at each epoch, the difference has u=√(0.5²+0.5²)=0.707 mm.
units.verify: 以穩定控制點重複觀測估計實際散布，分離儀器、立尺與環境貢獻；對小於可辨識程度的變化標記不確定，而不是強制畫成平順趨勢，並由測量主管核准資料品質旗標。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：以0.1 mm顯示位數宣稱0.1 mm準確度會過度解讀噪音，若只挑單次最大變化又會製造假警報；反覆誤報可能削弱團隊對真異常的反應。~Estimate field scatter from repeated stable controls and separate instrument, staff and environmental contributions; flag unresolved small changes instead of forcing a smooth trend, with quality flags approved by the survey lead. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Claiming 0.1 mm accuracy from display resolution overinterprets noise, while choosing the largest single difference creates false alarms. Repeated false alerts can weaken the response to genuine abnormal movement.
units.failure: 以0.1 mm顯示位數宣稱0.1 mm準確度會過度解讀噪音，若只挑單次最大變化又會製造假警報；反覆誤報可能削弱團隊對真異常的反應。~Claiming 0.1 mm accuracy from display resolution overinterprets noise, while choosing the largest single difference creates false alarms. Repeated false alerts can weaken the response to genuine abnormal movement.
units.misconception: 儀器顯示到十分之一毫米就具有同等實際準確度。~An instrument displaying tenths of a millimetre has the same actual accuracy.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄精度與差值不確定的資料來源與適用條件。以穩定控制點重複觀測估計實際散布，分離儀器、立尺與環境貢獻；對小於可辨識程度的變化標記不確定，而不是強制畫成平順趨勢，並由測量主管核准資料品質旗標。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for precision of displacement differences. Estimate field scatter from repeated stable controls and separate instrument, staff and environmental contributions; flag unresolved small changes instead of forcing a smooth trend, with quality flags approved by the survey lead.

units.anchor: 地下水下降與固結~Drawdown and consolidation
units.title: 地下水下降與固結~Drawdown and consolidation
units.mechanism: 水位降低可增加有效應力並引發延時固結，影響範圍未必與即時沉陷槽相同。必須分開孔壓下降與總應力變化，水位穿越土層改變單位重時，簡單γwΔh換算不能直接完整代表。 假設總應力不變且測點孔壓降低γwΔh，水頭降2 m使Δσ′=9.81×2=19.62 kPa；總重改變須另算。 把延時固結全歸為潛盾出土過多會選錯控制手段，反之將局部失土都當地下水效應又可能延誤處置；需要水文與施工證據共同辨識。~Drawdown may increase effective stress and cause delayed consolidation beyond the immediate trough. Separate pore-pressure reduction from changing total stress; when a water table crosses layers and changes unit weight, γwΔh alone is incomplete. Assume total stress remains fixed and point pore pressure falls by γwΔh; a 2 m head drop gives Δσ′=19.62 kPa, requiring separate treatment if total weight changes. Attributing all consolidation to excess muck removal selects the wrong control, while blaming localized ground loss on groundwater can delay action. Hydraulic and construction evidence are needed together.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設總應力不變且測點孔壓降低γwΔh，水頭降2 m使Δσ′=9.81×2=19.62 kPa；總重改變須另算。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume total stress remains fixed and point pore pressure falls by γwΔh; a 2 m head drop gives Δσ′=19.62 kPa, requiring separate treatment if total weight changes.
units.verify: 將多深度孔壓、地表沉陷與抽排水量同步，檢查沉陷是否在開挖通過後仍持續；以壓縮性試驗與排水邊界分析時間尺度，不能只憑兩條相似曲線宣稱因果。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：把延時固結全歸為潛盾出土過多會選錯控制手段，反之將局部失土都當地下水效應又可能延誤處置；需要水文與施工證據共同辨識。~Synchronize multilevel pore pressure, settlement and pumping, checking whether movement persists after passage; use compressibility tests and drainage boundaries to assess timescale rather than inferring causality from two similar curves alone. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Attributing all consolidation to excess muck removal selects the wrong control, while blaming localized ground loss on groundwater can delay action. Hydraulic and construction evidence are needed together.
units.failure: 把延時固結全歸為潛盾出土過多會選錯控制手段，反之將局部失土都當地下水效應又可能延誤處置；需要水文與施工證據共同辨識。~Attributing all consolidation to excess muck removal selects the wrong control, while blaming localized ground loss on groundwater can delay action. Hydraulic and construction evidence are needed together.
units.misconception: 水位下降時總應力永遠不變，可以無條件使用水頭換算。~Total stress never changes during drawdown, so head conversion applies unconditionally.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄地下水下降與固結的資料來源與適用條件。將多深度孔壓、地表沉陷與抽排水量同步，檢查沉陷是否在開挖通過後仍持續；以壓縮性試驗與排水邊界分析時間尺度，不能只憑兩條相似曲線宣稱因果。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for drawdown and consolidation. Synchronize multilevel pore pressure, settlement and pumping, checking whether movement persists after passage; use compressibility tests and drainage boundaries to assess timescale rather than inferring causality from two similar curves alone.

units.anchor: 施工里程與多源事件~Chainage and multiple events
units.title: 施工里程與多源事件~Chainage and multiple events
units.mechanism: 同一監測點可能受雙線隧道、車站開挖、灌漿與外部施工影響，位移對時間曲線需要連到各事件位置。將所有變化歸給最近掌子面會忽略延時與重疊，應建立可比較的事件索引。 假設掌子面距測點30 m、隧道直徑6 m，規一化距離x/D=5；兩條線比較需同樣定義正負方向。 錯誤時區或機器里程會將沉陷峰錯配施工階段，雙線效果重疊又可能被誤當第二條線單獨造成；這會扭曲事後經驗參數與責任判斷。~A point may respond to twin drives, station excavation, grouting and unrelated works. Time histories must connect to each event location. Assigning every change to the nearest face ignores delay and overlap, requiring a comparable event index. For assumed face distance 30 m and diameter 6 m, normalized distance x/D=5; comparing drives requires the same sign convention. Wrong time zones or machine chainage misassign settlement peaks to stages; overlapping twin-drive effects can be attributed entirely to the second drive, biasing empirical parameters and retrospective responsibility assessments.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設掌子面距測點30 m、隧道直徑6 m，規一化距離x/D=5；兩條線比較需同樣定義正負方向。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For assumed face distance 30 m and diameter 6 m, normalized distance x/D=5; comparing drives requires the same sign convention.
units.verify: 把位移同時對時間與規一化掌子面距離作圖，加入灌漿及抽水日誌；多事件重疊時比較未受同一事件影響的控制點，地工主管需列出可能成因及可區分它們的證據。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：錯誤時區或機器里程會將沉陷峰錯配施工階段，雙線效果重疊又可能被誤當第二條線單獨造成；這會扭曲事後經驗參數與責任判斷。~Plot movement against both time and normalized face distance, including grouting and pumping logs; use suitable control points during overlapping events and require the geotechnical lead to list competing causes and distinguishing evidence. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Wrong time zones or machine chainage misassign settlement peaks to stages; overlapping twin-drive effects can be attributed entirely to the second drive, biasing empirical parameters and retrospective responsibility assessments.
units.failure: 錯誤時區或機器里程會將沉陷峰錯配施工階段，雙線效果重疊又可能被誤當第二條線單獨造成；這會扭曲事後經驗參數與責任判斷。~Wrong time zones or machine chainage misassign settlement peaks to stages; overlapping twin-drive effects can be attributed entirely to the second drive, biasing empirical parameters and retrospective responsibility assessments.
units.misconception: 每個監測點的變形只能由距離最近的掌子面造成。~Movement at a monitoring point can only be caused by the nearest face.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄施工里程與多源事件的資料來源與適用條件。把位移同時對時間與規一化掌子面距離作圖，加入灌漿及抽水日誌；多事件重疊時比較未受同一事件影響的控制點，地工主管需列出可能成因及可區分它們的證據。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for chainage and multiple events. Plot movement against both time and normalized face distance, including grouting and pumping logs; use suitable control points during overlapping events and require the geotechnical lead to list competing causes and distinguishing evidence.

units.anchor: 警戒邏輯與量測確認~Trigger logic and measurement confirmation
units.title: 警戒邏輯與量測確認~Trigger logic and measurement confirmation
units.mechanism: 警戒值應連到可執行的回應與量測確認流程，而非只有紅黃綠色。位移、速率與結構症狀提供不同證據，持續超限和單點跳值需分辨，但不能以資料確認為由延誤已核准的緊急回應。 假設教學警戒比r=量測8 mm/審查值10 mm=0.8；此10 mm純為算例，現場需個案核准。 只依平均值判斷可能掩蓋單一敏感建物，儀器斷線被當成零位移更危險；若警報沒有指定接收者，即使系統正確偵測也未必產生回應。~Triggers require actionable responses and measurement confirmation, not only colors. Displacement, rate and structural symptoms provide different evidence; distinguish persistent exceedance from isolated jumps without delaying an approved emergency response. An assumed teaching trigger ratio is measured 8 mm/review value 10 mm=0.8; the 10 mm value is purely illustrative and requires project-specific approval in practice. Averages can hide one sensitive building, and treating lost communication as zero movement is worse. Without a named recipient, technically correct detection may still fail to produce a response.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設教學警戒比r=量測8 mm/審查值10 mm=0.8；此10 mm純為算例，現場需個案核准。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed teaching trigger ratio is measured 8 mm/review value 10 mm=0.8; the 10 mm value is purely illustrative and requires project-specific approval in practice.
units.verify: 用模擬資料演練超限通知、備援讀值與責任人接收，確認通訊斷線也會被標示；工程師審查門檻的依據、延遲與可採行措施，不能把本課比值部署成現場控制表。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：只依平均值判斷可能掩蓋單一敏感建物，儀器斷線被當成零位移更危險；若警報沒有指定接收者，即使系統正確偵測也未必產生回應。~Rehearse notification, backup readings and acknowledgment with synthetic data, including communication loss; engineers review criteria, latency and feasible actions, and the teaching ratio must not be deployed as a field control table. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Averages can hide one sensitive building, and treating lost communication as zero movement is worse. Without a named recipient, technically correct detection may still fail to produce a response.
units.failure: 只依平均值判斷可能掩蓋單一敏感建物，儀器斷線被當成零位移更危險；若警報沒有指定接收者，即使系統正確偵測也未必產生回應。~Averages can hide one sensitive building, and treating lost communication as zero movement is worse. Without a named recipient, technically correct detection may still fail to produce a response.
units.misconception: 大部分監測點正常就能取消少數敏感建物的超限警報。~Normal readings at most points justify canceling an exceedance at a sensitive building.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄警戒邏輯與量測確認的資料來源與適用條件。用模擬資料演練超限通知、備援讀值與責任人接收，確認通訊斷線也會被標示；工程師審查門檻的依據、延遲與可採行措施，不能把本課比值部署成現場控制表。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for trigger logic and measurement confirmation. Rehearse notification, backup readings and acknowledgment with synthetic data, including communication loss; engineers review criteria, latency and feasible actions, and the teaching ratio must not be deployed as a field control table.

units.anchor: 長期追蹤與結案~Long-term tracking and closeout
units.title: 長期追蹤與結案~Long-term tracking and closeout
units.mechanism: 施工通過不代表所有沉陷立即停止，黏土固結及地下水恢復可能延續。結案需有基準穩定、速率趨勢和建物狀況的共同證據，並保留後續營運期能銜接的坐標與時間基準。 假設連續四週增量0.8、0.4、0.2、0.1 mm，總增量1.5 mm；遞減趨勢不等於未來必定為零。 過早拆除基準會切斷延時沉陷的證據鏈，若只交最後讀值則無法追查速率；未明示剩餘不確定性，營運者可能誤以為已證實永久穩定。~Passage does not end settlement immediately; clay consolidation and groundwater recovery can continue. Closeout needs stable references, rate trends and asset condition together, preserving coordinates and time datums for operational monitoring. Assumed weekly increments 0.8,0.4,0.2 and 0.1 mm total 1.5 mm; a decreasing trend does not prove zero future movement. Removing benchmarks prematurely breaks evidence for delayed movement, while final readings alone lose rate history. Unstated residual uncertainty can lead an operator to assume that permanent stability has been demonstrated.
units.model: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設連續四週增量0.8、0.4、0.2、0.1 mm，總增量1.5 mm；遞減趨勢不等於未來必定為零。~The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assumed weekly increments 0.8,0.4,0.2 and 0.1 mm total 1.5 mm; a decreasing trend does not prove zero future movement.
units.verify: 以固定方法檢查長期讀值、孔壓恢復和既有裂縫，說明監測停止或降頻的個案依據；交付原始資料、校正歷程與未解決項，由業主及工程負責人共同確認接管條件。驗證亦須釐清下列替代解釋：過早拆除基準會切斷延時沉陷的證據鏈，若只交最後讀值則無法追查速率；未明示剩餘不確定性，營運者可能誤以為已證實永久穩定。~Review long-term levels, pressure recovery and existing cracks consistently, justifying any reduced frequency or cessation; deliver raw data, corrections and unresolved issues for joint owner and engineering approval of handover conditions. Verification must also resolve this competing explanation: Removing benchmarks prematurely breaks evidence for delayed movement, while final readings alone lose rate history. Unstated residual uncertainty can lead an operator to assume that permanent stability has been demonstrated.
units.failure: 過早拆除基準會切斷延時沉陷的證據鏈，若只交最後讀值則無法追查速率；未明示剩餘不確定性，營運者可能誤以為已證實永久穩定。~Removing benchmarks prematurely breaks evidence for delayed movement, while final readings alone lose rate history. Unstated residual uncertainty can lead an operator to assume that permanent stability has been demonstrated.
units.misconception: 掌子面通過後就可以立刻認定延時沉陷已經結束。~Face passage immediately establishes that all delayed settlement has ended.
units.practice: 交接時逐項記錄長期追蹤與結案的資料來源與適用條件。以固定方法檢查長期讀值、孔壓恢復和既有裂縫，說明監測停止或降頻的個案依據；交付原始資料、校正歷程與未解決項，由業主及工程負責人共同確認接管條件。~At handover, document the evidence and applicable conditions for long-term tracking and closeout. Review long-term levels, pressure recovery and existing cracks consistently, justifying any reduced frequency or cessation; deliver raw data, corrections and unresolved issues for joint owner and engineering approval of handover conditions.

example: 原創教學算例，所有輸入是為比較機制而假設，並非任何地標的實測資料。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設Smax=10 mm、i=5 m，x=5 m處S=10e⁻⁰·⁵=6.07 mm；假設沉陷向下為正。以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設Smax=0.01 m、i=5 m，Vs=√(2π)iSmax=0.1253 m²；直徑6 m面積28.274 m²，VL=0.443%。將第一式的一個線性乘數加倍而固定其他邊界，該項貢獻隨之加倍；若為非線性式則必須重新代入，不能等比例外推。把輸入值、單位換算、計算結果及假設列成四欄，再用獨立計算器重算；最後比較量測誤差與模型簡化，判斷改變是否足以支持工程決策。~Original teaching example: all inputs are assumptions for comparing mechanisms, not measurements from a landmark project. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume Smax=10 mm and i=5 m; at x=5 m, S=10e⁻⁰·⁵=6.07 mm, taking downward settlement as positive. The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Assume Smax=0.01 m and i=5 m; Vs=√(2π)iSmax=0.1253 m². A 6 m diameter gives area 28.274 m² and VL=0.443%. Doubling one linear multiplicative input in the first relation while holding the remaining boundaries fixed doubles that contribution; a nonlinear relation must instead be evaluated again. Tabulate inputs, unit conversions, results and assumptions in separate columns, and recalculate independently. Finally compare measurement uncertainty with model simplification before deciding whether the difference supports an engineering decision.
history: 美國聯邦公路管理局於2009年發行公路隧道土建技術手冊，整理調查與土建工程的公開原理；瑞士官方介紹聖哥達基線隧道長57公里並於2016年投入營運，提供深埋長隧道的工程環境對照。Crossrail於2017年公開完工後地質縱剖面，提醒讀者鑽孔密度、偏離隧道位置與簡化斷層會限制推論。這些出版節點顯示以基準穩定、沉陷槽形與時間關聯區分開挖及地下水影響需要把原始紀錄和模型分開保存；地標僅供工程環境比較，本課只重建公開原理。~FHWA issued its civil-elements road-tunnel manual in 2009, collecting public investigation and civil-engineering principles. Swiss government information records the 57 km Gotthard Base Tunnel entering operation in 2016, providing context for long deep tunnels. Crossrail published a post-construction geological section in 2017, explaining limitations from borehole density, offset and simplified faults. These publication milestones show why separate excavation and groundwater effects using stable benchmarks, trough geometry and time correlation requires original observations to be preserved separately from interpretations. Landmarks provide contextual comparisons only; this course reconstructs public principles.
facts: 教學量化備忘：假設Smax=10 mm、i=5 m，x=5 m處S=10e⁻⁰·⁵=6.07 mm；假設沉陷向下為正。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume Smax=10 mm and i=5 m; at x=5 m, S=10e⁻⁰·⁵=6.07 mm, taking downward settlement as positive.

教學量化備忘：假設Smax=0.01 m、i=5 m，Vs=√(2π)iSmax=0.1253 m²；直徑6 m面積28.274 m²，VL=0.443%。~Teaching quantitative note: Assume Smax=0.01 m and i=5 m; Vs=√(2π)iSmax=0.1253 m². A 6 m diameter gives area 28.274 m² and VL=0.443%.

教學量化備忘：假設觀測點讀得下沉8 mm，基準本身下沉3 mm，真實相對外部穩定基準沉陷為11 mm。~Teaching quantitative note: If an assumed point appears to settle 8 mm relative to a benchmark that itself settles 3 mm, settlement relative to a stable external datum is 11 mm.

教學量化備忘：假設兩支點距10 m、高差5 mm，角變化Δ/L=0.0005 rad=1/2000；非通用損害門檻。~Teaching quantitative note: For assumed support spacing 10 m and differential movement 5 mm, Δ/L=0.0005 rad=1/2000; this is not a universal damage threshold.

教學量化備忘：假設24 h沉陷增加2 mm，平均速率0.0833 mm/h；若同變化集中在2 h則局部平均1 mm/h。~Teaching quantitative note: An assumed 2 mm increase over 24 h averages 0.0833 mm/h; if concentrated within 2 h, the local average is 1 mm/h.

教學量化備忘：假設兩次高程各標準不確定0.5 mm且獨立，差值u=√(0.5²+0.5²)=0.707 mm。~Teaching quantitative note: Assuming independent elevation standard uncertainties of 0.5 mm at each epoch, the difference has u=√(0.5²+0.5²)=0.707 mm.
